stories.title: Exercise Pitch Black 2026 concludes (7 August)
stories.body: the IAF contingent returns from the biennial multinational air exercise in northern Australia (4 Rafales, 2 C-17s, 120+ Air Warriors; ~100 aircraft, 20 nations).
